items.label: T1 Standard
items.definition: Low-sensitivity academic, behavioural, communication and portfolio data. Standard product access rules; external sharing only with purpose-specific consent.
items.modelUseRule: May inform profile and decisions when evidence quality is adequate.

items.label: T2 Elevated
items.definition: Family, financial, psychological and identity-adjacent context. Role-restricted; not shown to the other party verbatim; not exported by default.
items.modelUseRule: Use only for the purpose it was collected for; avoid proxy discrimination and do not turn context into a global ability penalty.

items.label: T3 Sensitive Health
items.definition: Sleep, nutrition, stress, neurodiversity and clinical documents. Separate encrypted store, purpose-limited to support and accommodations.
items.modelUseRule: Excluded from ranking, admissions fit, career fit and work allocation; support adaptation only.

items.label: C Consent Artefact
items.definition: Versioned, granular consent/assent records, revocable and re-collected when required.
items.modelUseRule: Govern processing; never treated as a learner characteristic.
